Class SimpleRayTracer

java.lang.Object
renderer.RayTracerBase
renderer.SimpleRayTracer
class SimpleRayTracer extends RayTracerBase
A ray tracer implementing the Phong reflection model with Global Illumination. Supports soft shadows, reflections, and refractions.

    • transparency

      private Double3 transparency(Intersectable.Intersection intersection)
      Computes the accumulated transparency factor along the shadow ray from the intersection point to the current light source. Uses intersection.l and intersection.light from the cache (both set by preprocessLightSource).
      Parameters:
      intersection - the current intersection (light cache must be populated)
      Returns:
      accumulated kT factor; Double3.ONE means fully unblocked, Double3.ZERO means fully in shadow

    • unshaded

      private boolean unshaded(Intersectable.Intersection intersection)
      Checks whether a point is unshaded from the current light source. An opaque geometry (kT below threshold) fully blocks the light. A partially transparent geometry does NOT block it. Kept alongside transparency(Intersectable.Intersection) so the professor can evaluate the Part I/II shadow approach independently.
      Parameters:
      intersection - the current intersection (light cache must be populated)
      Returns:
      true if the point receives light (not in shadow)
